component.name: Disc Image Studio
component.summary: Design artwork that appears on the data side of optical discs
Crie artes que aparecem no lado gravado de discos ópticos

description.p: Disc Image Studio turns an image into disc data that meets the physical-layer constraints of CD, DVD and single-layer BD-R, so that after burning the pattern becomes visible on the disc.
Design the disc surface with layers, preview how the disc will read back, export the image with integrity checks, calibrate the geometry of your drive and media from a photo, and burn.

Desenhe a superfície do disco em camadas, veja na prévia como o disco será lido, exporte a imagem com verificações de integridade, calibre a geometria do seu gravador e mídia a partir de uma foto e grave.
